about: The forests, made by MapCreation/Scripts/forests/f1_forests.py. Coordinates are the pictures' pixels, a whole number being the middle of a pixel. A forest runs on under the lakes, and up to 4 px out over the sea: the scene cuts it at the coast's own line, county by county (../Scripts/scene/forestshapes.py).

fields.forests: id (by size, the largest first); km2 (its area on land, the lakes in it counted); clearings (how many holes it has); outline: its edge, all the way round; holes: the edges of the clearings in it
fields.kinds: base: each kingdom's kind of forest; conifer_above_m: the height (m) over which a kingdom's forest is conifer instead; swamp: in kingdom 7, the swamp country is swamp forest, the rest broadleaf (conifer over its height); regions: where the land is over each height (above_600 ...), and the swamp country, as outlines with holes
fields.figures: by kingdom: target and share of its land (lakes left out) under forest, its km2, and the shares cleared by people and where nothing would grow, as worked out on the pixels
